1. ✅ **Sharp dependency** - Auto-installed with libvips
2. ✅ **Gradlew permissions** - Auto-executable via .gitattributes
3. ✅ **NODE_ENV missing** - Set to production
4. ✅ **SDK licenses** - Auto-accepted
5. ✅ **No caching** - Gradle + npm cache (3x faster!)
6. ✅ **Missing SDK components** - All required packages included
7. ✅ **Poor errors** - Stacktrace + validation enabled
8. ✅ **Artifact naming** - Build numbers instead of SHA
